coverage_exempt.reason: Original null operator-new result sets EDI to zero here and immediately dereferences it at 0x456b5e; verified original-only failure probe faults reading address zero. No successful original execution can take this branch.

Original 0x4db6e0 sets EBP to the null realloc result at 0x4db70b or 0x4db77f, then calls 0x4dc680, whose mov eax,[ebp+4] faults reading address 4. Verified original-only failure probe; table growth cannot return failure to this block.

The second registry expansion is unreachable: the first lookup either starts in bounds or original 0x4db6e0 expands bounds to include the state. Between lookups only scratch at registry+0x20 is written, with no callback. The first failed expansion faults inside 0x4dc680 before returning.

The second registry expansion cannot execute after a successful first lookup: bounds still include the unchanged state and no callback intervenes. Moreover, either expansion returning null would first fault at original 0x4dc680 after realloc sets EBP to zero.

Original 0x4571a5/0x4571a8 overwrites acceleration Y with 2000.0; the squared acceleration sum at 0x45723b is at least 4000000 for finite values. Hash-checked original constants scale this by 0.25 and compare against +/-0.1, so normalization is impossible. Infinity exceeds the bound; unordered values take the C0 branch at 0x4572b2 (or the earlier speed rejection).

equivalent_mutants.reason: The deleted sign change corresponds to original FCHS at 0x4572a7, negating the epsilon before comparison. Original 0x4571a5/0x4571a8 fixes acceleration Y to 2000.0, so squared magnitude times 0.25 is at least 1000000. Comparing it with +0.1 or -0.1 gives identical ordering; infinity is greater and unordered has the same C0 result. Both compared operands are popped at 0x4572ab, so the changed epsilon cannot affect later arithmetic. Verified original constants through hash-checked claw().
